description: MachineUser is the Schema for the machineusers API.

spec.description: MachineUserSpec defines the desired state of MachineUser.

accessTokenType.description: AccessTokenType specifies the access token format for this machine user.

description.description: Description is an optional description of the machine user.

instance.description:
Instance optionally pins this resource to one operator's instance
identity — the operator config's instanceAlias, defaulting to its
domain (v0.18 dual-serving). When set to another identity, the CR is
ignored entirely so the owning operator can manage it. When empty
while the namespace is served by two operators, both fail closed with
an AmbiguousInstance condition.

key.description: Key configures machine key lifecycle (v0.18, INF-426).

rotateAfter.description:
RotateAfter enables dual-key rotation: once the current key is older
than this duration, a new key is minted and swapped into the Secret;
the old key is revoked after RotationGrace (two keys coexist during
the overlap). Example: "2160h" (90 days). Empty = never rotate
(pre-v0.18 behavior).

rotationGrace.description:
RotationGrace is how long the old key stays valid after rotation.
Defaults to 5m.

keySecretRef.description: KeySecretRef references the Secret where the generated key JSON will be stored.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret. Default: "key.json"

name.description: Name is the name of the Secret.

Name is the display name of the machine user.
If empty, the Kubernetes resource name is used.

organizationId.description:
OrganizationId references a pre-existing Zitadel organization by raw ID.
Mutually exclusive with OrganizationRef.

organizationRef.description:
OrganizationRef references an Organization CR managed by this operator.
Mutually exclusive with OrganizationId.

name.description: Name is the name of the referenced resource.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the namespace of the referenced resource.
If empty, defaults to the same namespace as the referencing resource.

projectId.description:
ProjectId references a pre-existing Zitadel project by raw ID as the
role grant target. Only used with Roles.
Mutually exclusive with ProjectRef.

projectRef.description:
ProjectRef references a Project CR whose project the role grant is
created on (v0.19 fleet shape: declare the project in-namespace and
grant roles on it without scope maps). Only used with Roles.
Mutually exclusive with ProjectId.

name.description: Name is the name of the referenced resource.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the namespace of the referenced resource.
If empty, defaults to the same namespace as the referencing resource.

roles.description:
Roles are project role grants for this machine user (v0.18, INF-426).
The grant target is, in order of precedence: the project named by
ProjectRef/ProjectId (v0.19), the namespace's resolved scope project
(scope maps), or a previously recorded status.projectId. Grants never
widen beyond the resolved scope when scope maps are active.

userName.description: UserName is the login name for the machine user.

status.description: MachineUserStatus defines the observed state of MachineUser.

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the resource's state.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

grantId.description: GrantId is the Zitadel user grant carrying spec.roles (v0.18).

keyCreatedAt.description: KeyCreatedAt is when the current key was minted.

keyId.description: KeyId is the current machine key (v0.18 rotation bookkeeping).

lastSyncTime.description: LastSyncTime is the last time the resource was synced with Zitadel.

organizationId.description: OrganizationId is the resolved organization ID.

previousKeyId.description: PreviousKeyId is the rotated-out key awaiting revocation.

previousKeyRevokeAt.description: PreviousKeyRevokeAt is when the rotated-out key gets revoked.

projectId.description: ProjectId is the scope project the roles are granted on (v0.18).

ready.description: Ready indicates whether the MachineUser is successfully synced.

userId.description: UserId is the Zitadel user ID.
